patch_description: Replace the CRZ gate acting on qubits [2, 5] with CRY under the "ent_lr" parameter. This adds Y-axis controlled rotation diversity to the long-range entangling block, which currently relies entirely on Z-axis (CRZ). The axis diversification should help the circuit learn better feature separations for the hardest validation samples, improving worst_group_margin from 0.35 back toward 0.36+. This mirrors the success of axis-mixed parametrized gates in prior versions.
